text: airbag
This is the airbag. The airbag is in the steering wheel.
Do not open the airbag cover.
instrument cluster
This is the instrument cluster. It shows the speed and the fuel.
fuel gauge
This is the fuel gauge. The tank is almost empty.
temperature gauge
This is the temperature gauge. The engine is hot.
turn signal
This is the turn signal. Use the turn signal to turn left.
The right turn signal does not work.
wiper stalk
This is the wiper stalk. Push it up to turn on the wipers.
start button
This is the start button. Press the clutch and push the start button.
car key
This is the car key. Do not forget the car key.
The car key has a battery.
hood release lever
This is the hood release lever. Pull it to open the hood.
footrest
This is the footrest. Put your left foot here.
floor mat
This is the floor mat. The floor mat is dirty.
Take out the floor mats, please.
USB port
This is the USB port. Connect your phone here.
12-volt socket
This is the 12-volt socket. Plug the charger in here.
armrest
This is the armrest. Rest your arm here.
door lock
This is the door lock. Lock the door, please.
The door lock does not work.
door pocket
This is the door pocket. Put the map in the door pocket.
seat belt buckle
This is the seat belt buckle. Click the buckle.
